description: Repairs r-cursor-1/edit-conflict-optimistic: the stored result after A's second Update was never read back; only A's own buffer was read. Open a second Database db2 on the same file. Cursor A: dynaset on G in db with LockEdits False; cursor B: dynaset on G in db2. (a) Same field: A Edit row 'r1', set U 'optA'; B Edit row 'r1', set U 'optB', Update; A Update, read Errors, EditMode, U; A Update again, read Errors, U; a new snapshot through db and one through db2 read every row of G (ID, T, N, U); A Move 0 and read U. (b) Other field: both MoveNext to row 'r2'; A Edit, set U 'optC'; B Edit, set N 77, Update; A Update, read Errors, EditMode, U, N; A Update again, read Errors; new snapshots through db and db2 read every row of G; A Move 0 and read U and N. Asks the optimistic conflict outcome per field overlap, the buffer after a refused Update and after a second explicit Update, and what is stored. The fixture copy is opened read-write.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
